title: Planning a car swap ahead of spring?

Planning a car swap ahead of spring?

More useful content from Bidders Highway on the way!
Jacob OdqvistJanuary 19, 2023 16:00
Welcome back after a hopefully lovely Christmas and New Year. 2023 has gotten off to a flying start, and we are rapidly approaching the time of year when the most enthusiast cars change owners. 

At Bidders Highway we are busy visiting collections and photographing cars, and we predict a very exciting spring. With this in mind, over the coming period we will be sending out a number of newsletters where we take a closer look at what to consider if you are planning to sell your enthusiast cars or motorcycles. Or if you are simply planning an addition to the garage!

Going forward we will give simple tips and advice that really make a difference when selling, as well as take an extra look at various models that we predict have a bright future in terms of popularity and demand. 

We continue with our offer where we also give sellers free photography of their car if they choose to sell with us this spring. 

Keep an eye out, we'll be in touch soon.

The team at Bidders Highway
